=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .

=> < Device | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .
[B4] < Device | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ... > < Cloud | UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'sendKey' Device | (Key)
=> < Device | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > .
[B5] < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | ... > $ UserX 'discover' Device
=> < Device | 'key' : Key , ... > $ Device 'bind' Cloud | (Key) .
[B5] < Cloud | Device : ('owner' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > $ Device 'bind' Cloud | (Key)
=> < Cloud | Device : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , UserY : ('key' : Key , ...) , ... > .
